steps.caption: Open More → Automation, then Budgets & usage.
A budget is a daily or monthly limit. When it is reached, non-critical background work pauses — nothing is lost — and admins are alerted.
Choose the resource — here 'research' (company research look-ups).
Unit: calls (other resources use USD, credits, seconds, pages or runs).
Limit: 10 calls a month. Alert at 80% warns admins before the limit.
The budget line shows used / limit, the alert level and when it resets.
A budget never switches to another provider to keep going — it just pauses.
Usage this month: by resource, AI cost by module and by workflow.
Each notification says what happened and links to the record. Here: a requirement change reassessed the Zentrix comparisons.
Done: you dealt with it. Snooze 3h: bring it back later. Dismiss: remove it (it stays in the history).
Snooze this one for three hours.
Similar notices are grouped, urgent ones come straight away, others wait for working hours and quiet hours.
The bell at the top of every page shows the same list.
